title: Local effectivity of uniformly bounded normalized constructible towers
statement: Let $T$ be a Noetherian scheme and let $(A,I)$ be an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], with $R_n=(A/I^n)_T$ and $A_T=\varprojlim R_n$ on $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$. Let $M_\bullet\in D(\operatorname{Tow}_A(T))$ be supplied with level objects $M_n\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(R_n))$ identifying their restrictions of scalars with its evaluations. Suppose there are normalization isomorphisms $M_{n+1}\otimes^L_{R_{n+1}}R_n\cong M_n$ whose scalar-extension maps induce its transitions and which satisfy the quotient cocycle. Assume each cohomology sheaf of each $M_n$ is constructible in the intrinsic finite-stratification, finite-lisse sense of [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf], and that there are integers $a\leq b$, independent of $n$, with $\mathcal H^q(M_n)=0$ for $q\notin[a,b]$. Then each $M_n$ has bounded constructible etale origin in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], and $M_\bullet$ admits the common finite stratification, pro-etale coverings, bounded adic-lisse finite-type local complexes, and normalization-compatible reduction isomorphisms required by [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]; in particular it is uniformly bounded constructible in that full sense. The local terms are not asserted to be projective. This assertion requires both the normalized derived reductions and the common cohomological interval, not merely levelwise constructibility.

source.place: Tag 09AL (lemma-compare-constructible-derived) gives the finite-level etale-origin conclusion for any Noetherian coefficient ring. Tags 09BU (lemma-Noetherian-constructible), 09BV (lemma-weird), 09BW (lemma-connected-lisse), and 09BX (lemma-Noetherian-adic-constructible), for finite-type adic sheaves, with Tag 09AV (more-algebra-lemma-Rlim-pseudo-coherent-gives-complete-pseudo-coherent) in more-algebra.tex. Agent assembly for uniformly bounded normalized derived systems. Tags 09C3/09C6/09C7 supply the parallel finite-Tor derived argument, but are not claimed to state this non-finite-Tor criterion.

proof.text: Since $P_n$ is finite, it is Noetherian. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-finite-ring-constructible-derived-origin] to $M_n$ with its interval $[a,b]$. This proves the first conclusion and gives bounded constructible etale witnesses $K_n$ with $\nu_T^*K_n\simeq M_n$. Derived tensor commutes with inverse image by [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Thus the etale source $K_{n+1}\otimes^L_{P_{n+1}}P_n$ pulls back to the supplied normalized $M_n$, which is bounded. Exactness and the sheaf unit isomorphism in [prop-weil-pbc-site-comparison-finite-level] imply that inverse image commutes with cohomology and detects zero sheaves; hence this etale source is bounded as well. Full faithfulness on $D^+$ in [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison] now lifts each normalization and its inverse uniquely, as well as the transitions after restricting to the higher coefficient ring. Faithfulness carries the given quotient cocycle to the etale witnesses. We do not apply bounded-below full faithfulness to a potentially unbounded derived tensor without first checking its bound.

Choose the finite stratifications witnessing constructibility of the finitely many sheaves $\mathcal H^q(K_1)$, $a\leq q\leq b$, and intersect their strata. Finite intersections of locally closed subsets are locally closed, and these intersections form a finite partition; give them the iterated fibre-product subscheme structures. Refine to connected strata. A Noetherian space has finitely many irreducible components, each connected, so its connected components are finite unions of those components; their complements are closed, hence they are open and closed. Thus this refinement remains finite and locally closed. On every resulting connected stratum $S$, the cohomology of $K_1|_S$ is finite lisse. The empty scheme has the empty partition and the zero complex as its local model.

source.place: Tag 09AI constructible criterion; elementary finite refinement

proof.text: Fix a stratum $S$ and a level $n$. Put $B=P_n$ and $J=I/I^n$. The complex $K_n|_S$ is bounded above, and its derived reduction to $B/J=P_1$ is $K_1|_S$ by repeated normalization and its cocycle. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-nilpotent-reduction-lissity]. Since $J^n=0$, it follows that every cohomology sheaf of $K_n|_S$ is locally constant of finite type. Over the finite ring $P_n$ these stalks are finite sets. The original interval $[a,b]$ is preserved by the exact inverse image along the immersion. This uses no finite Tor bound over $P_n$.

source.place: Tag 094I, lemma-locally-constant-bounded, with the nilpotent ideal I/I^n

proof.text: Choose a geometric point $\bar s$ of the nonempty connected $S$ and let $E_n=(K_n|_S)_{\bar s}$. Stalks are exact by [prop-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks-exact] and are inverse images at the geometric point by [lem-kun-stalk-as-pullback]; the tensor-pullback theorem therefore makes them commute with derived scalar extension; hence $E_n$ has finite cohomology in $[a,b]$, and the stalks of the normalizations give $E_{n+1}\otimes^L_{P_{n+1}}P_n\simeq E_n$ with the same cocycle. By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-ring-derived-local-constancy], each $K_n|_S$ is locally isomorphic to $\underline E_n$ and its sheaf $\mathcal I_n$ of such isomorphisms is finite locally constant with nonempty stalks. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-compatible-finite-derived-trivializations] to these sheaves and the two normalized systems. It gives a pro-etale covering $U\to S$ and simultaneously compatible isomorphisms $h_n:\underline E_n|_U\simeq M_n|_U$. Restrictions of the witnesses agree with the witnesses on the stratum by [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback].

source.place: Agent finite-isomorphism-sheaf variant of Tag 09BV, lemma-weird; constant models from Tag 094G

proof.text: Put $C=\widehat A=\varprojlim P_n$ and $J=IC$. The ring is Noetherian and $J$-adically complete by [lem-weil-pbc-completion-noetherian-quotient-noetherian], since $A/I$ is Noetherian and $I$ is finitely generated. Its quotients $C/J^n=P_n$ are the completion quotient identities of [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence], applied on the one-point site. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-pseudocoherent-normalized-algebra-tower] to the algebraic system $E_n$. It supplies a pseudo-coherent $E=R\varprojlim E_n$ and compatible reduction isomorphisms $E\otimes_C^L P_n\simeq E_n$. The Noetherian finite-cohomology hypothesis for $E_1$ holds because $P_1$ is finite and $E_1$ is bounded.

Each group $H^q(E_n)$ is finite. By [lem-weil-pbc-mittag-leffler], its inverse system has $\varprojlim{}^1=0$. The Milnor exact sequence [lem-pc-derived-limit-milnor-sequence] therefore identifies $H^q(E)$ with $\varprojlim H^q(E_n)$, so $E$ has cohomology only in $[a,b]$. Choose a bounded-above finite free representative $P^\bullet\to E$ with $P^q=0$ for $q>b$ by [lem-pc-pseudo-coherent-bounded-finite-free-model]. Set $Q^q=P^q$ for $a<q\leq b$, $Q^a=\operatorname{coker}(P^{a-1}\to P^a)$, and $Q^q=0$ otherwise. The differential out of $Q^a$ is well-defined because $d^a d^{a-1}=0$. The quotient map $P\to Q$ induces the same cohomology in degrees $q\geq a$ and kills an acyclic lower tail because $H^q(P)=0$ for $q<a$; it is a quasi-isomorphism. Thus $Q$ is a single bounded complex of finite $C$-modules in $[a,b]$. Its first term need not be projective. The construction does not tensor the truncation underived.

source.place: Tag 07KY Milnor sequence, Tag 064U finite free representative; elementary good truncation

proof.text: On each covering member $U$ realize $Q$ termwise by $L=c_U(Q)$ using [lem-weil-pbc-completed-constant-finite-complex-realization]. It is supported in $[a,b]$ and its terms are adic lisse of finite type. Regard it as an $A_T|_U$-complex by the projection-induced coefficient map. The relative clause of that lemma gives natural compatible isomorphisms $t_n:L\otimes^L_{A_T|_U}R_n|_U\simeq\underline{E_n}|_U$. This explicitly uses the restricted completed coefficient ring, not an equality between its inverse image and a completed ring formed anew on $U$. All the reduction cohomology sheaves are constant finite $P_n$-module sheaves because $E_n$ has finite cohomology. The interval for terms is the same $[a,b]$ on all strata and covering members.

source.place: Agent completed-constant realization; Tag 09BV completed local models

proof.text: Define $e_n=t_n^{-1}h_n^{-1}:M_n|_U\simeq L\otimes^L_{A_T|_U}R_n|_U$. The equation for the compatible trivializations is $h_n\eta_n=\rho_n(h_{n+1}\otimes^L R_n)$. Naturality of the realization isomorphisms gives $t_n\sigma_n=\eta_n(t_{n+1}\otimes^L R_n)$. Substituting the definition of $e_n$ into these two equations gives $e_n\rho_n=\sigma_n(e_{n+1}\otimes^L R_n)$, exactly the normalization-compatibility equation of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. The common stratification, covering and complexes constructed above satisfy every clause of that definition, with $d_0=a,d_1=b$.
